notes.title: Free to play
notes.notes: Son of Aral is going to be free to play in about one week,apologies for the players who have already bought the game, if you bought the game in this month and you would like a refund, please contact me.Currently the game's income cannot support me to develop the game further,so for now this game will not have more updates, and I want to make this game free to let more players play this game.
